title: Texas Instruments worker given unknown metal

tellings.quote: You know a famous example is the infographic show whistleblower where he talks about a guy at Texas Instruments getting a piece of metal and not knowing what he's working on.

plain: A worker at Texas Instruments, an American electronics company, was reportedly handed a piece of metal to study without being told what it was or where it came from. The story comes from an anonymous whistleblower who told it on a YouTube channel called The Infographics Show, and a guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb repeats it on Michels' show. He offers it as a well-known example of companies quietly working on recovered material without knowing its source.
